verdict.rationale: OpenHands documents sandbox infrastructure for agent execution: an Apptainer sandbox guide for the agent server, Cloud's managed 'sandbox infrastructure', and running agents in Docker or on VMs. This is genuine container-level isolation rather than a dry-run, but the evidence never describes the isolation guarantees or shows the agent installing dependencies inside the sandbox. missing for 10: explicit documentation of the isolation and safety boundaries, evidence of dependency installation inside the sandbox, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can have an agent safely execute code and install dependencies inside an isolated sandbox

citations.quote: Apptainer (formerly Singularity) is a container runtime designed for HPC environments that doesn't require root access
without operating your own backend and sandbox infrastructure
Run agents locally, in Docker, on VMs
